rationale: The original short thesis relied on price remaining suppressed below session VWAP ($108.27) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($108.45), both of which have now been reclaimed. The last five 1-minute candles have consistently held lows above VWAP while the broader market has stabilized slightly (SPY recovering from -0.66% to -0.57%), indicating that immediate downward momentum has stalled. Exiting now limits the loss rather than holding through continued consolidation above key intraday support.
